title: RFC 9360 COSE_X509 and COSE_CertHash, as a JSON projection
description: DERIVED - not verbatim. RFC 9360 defines no JSON encoding and no JSON Schema; 'JSON Schema' and 'schema' occur zero times in its 614 lines. This is a projection of the two CDDL rules at source lines 311-312 (rfc-9360#R-0069, rfc-9360#R-0070) onto JSON for test-fixture validation, in which CBOR byte strings become base64url strings. IT IS NOT AN INTERCHANGE FORMAT and no RFC 9360 message is JSON. The one-element array is INVALID in both the CDDL and here, because `2*` requires at least two.

b64.description: a CBOR byte string, base64url without padding

COSE_X509.description: bstr / [ 2*certs: bstr ] - a DER certificate, or two or more of them. Each byte string holds ASN.1 DER, which neither CDDL nor JSON Schema can constrain.

COSE_CertHash.description: [ hashAlg: (int / tstr), hashValue: bstr ] - EXACTLY TWO FIELDS, so the purpose of the hash cannot be carried. RFC 9360 restricts hashAlg to no subset of the COSE Algorithms registry.
